note: BLIND DETECTOR VALIDATION. ⛔ The boundary detector was written AFTER seeing the failures it catches — it has been evaluated on the evidence that inspired it. 12/13 on that corpus is KNOWN-CORPUS DISCRIMINATION, not generalization. This set exists to ask whether it recognizes risky claims it has never seen.
what_is_frozen: BOTH. The corpus is frozen at commit AND the detector is frozen by hash. ⛔ Otherwise the detector could be improved against every miss until it perfectly recognizes the corpus that taught us what to look for.
design_note: ⭐⭐ SEVEN OF THE TEN LICENSED CASES DELIBERATELY CONTAIN LIMITING LANGUAGE — `since`, `before`, `three times`, `for eleven seasons`, `unless`, `after`, `until`. A detector that flags any limiter will be caught by these, and an honest false-positive cost can only be measured on material where limiters appear in BOTH directions.

expected_values.entailed: the premise commits to the hypothesis
expected_values.not_entailed: the premise does not commit (neutral) OR denies it (contradiction)

cases.premise: Yusuf tended the vineyard until the estate was sold.
cases.origin: closed interval

cases.premise: Yusuf has tended the vineyard since the estate changed hands.
cases.origin: ⭐ `since` — a temporal marker that OPENS rather than closes

cases.premise: Marta ran the tea house before she moved to the coast.
cases.origin: cessation by relocation

cases.premise: Marta has run the tea house since before the bypass was built.
cases.origin: ⭐⭐ `before` PRESENT AND LICENSED — the word alone must not decide

cases.premise: Dov joined the bell foundry after the fire.
cases.hypothesis: Dov worked at the bell foundry before the fire.
cases.origin: ordering: joining after excludes the earlier period

cases.premise: Dov joined the bell foundry after the fire and is there still.
cases.hypothesis: Dov works at the bell foundry.
cases.origin: ⭐ `after` present, licensed by `still`

cases.premise: Ingrid has led the dawn walk three times.
cases.origin: count read as a standing arrangement

cases.premise: Ingrid leads the dawn walk three times a week.
cases.origin: ⭐⭐ `three times` PRESENT AND LICENSED — the sharpest false-positive test in the set

cases.premise: Paulo minded the canal lock for one season.
cases.origin: bounded duration, past

cases.premise: Paulo has minded the canal lock for eleven seasons and shows no sign of stopping.
cases.origin: ⭐ duration that CORROBORATES — the false-positive class the known corpus already exposed

cases.premise: Runa is standing in as harbourmaster while the post is advertised.
cases.origin: covering a role is not holding it

cases.premise: Runa was confirmed as harbourmaster in the spring and holds the post.
cases.origin: licensed; carries a past date

cases.premise: Hiroshi and the seed bank parted ways last autumn.
cases.hypothesis: Hiroshi works with the seed bank.
cases.origin: ⛔ cessation with NO listed limiter token — `parted ways` is not in the detector's vocabulary

cases.premise: Hiroshi has worked with the seed bank every autumn since it opened.
cases.hypothesis: Hiroshi works with the seed bank.
cases.origin: licensed and recurring

cases.premise: If the hail holds off, Zsófia will open the glasshouse.
cases.origin: conditional and future

cases.premise: Zsófia opens the glasshouse each morning unless the hail is heavy.
cases.origin: ⭐ `unless` present and licensed — a condition that qualifies without cancelling

cases.premise: Amara climbed with the gym's team until her wrist gave out.
cases.hypothesis: Amara climbs with the gym's team.
cases.origin: interruption that ended it

cases.premise: Amara climbs with the gym's team, though she sat out two months with a broken wrist.
cases.hypothesis: Amara climbs with the gym's team.
cases.origin: ⭐⭐ interruption present and licensed — the relation survives the gap

cases.premise: Kian trained as a bookbinder before turning to cabinetmaking.
cases.origin: identity superseded

cases.premise: Kian trained as a bookbinder and has bound books for thirty years.
cases.origin: licensed by sustained practice

cases.premise: Esme kept the observatory logs until the new director arrived.
cases.origin: second `until` case — the confirmed weak family carries an extra

cases.premise: Tobias has stood in at the radio station on two occasions.
cases.hypothesis: Tobias presents at the radio station.
cases.origin: ⛔ `on two occasions` — a frequency bound the detector's patterns do not list
